versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Staging covers osteosarcoma and Ewing sarcoma of the appendicular skeleton, trunk, skull and facial bones (spine and pelvis use a separate 8th-edition scheme with compartment-based T). T is size-based with an 8 cm cutoff, and discontinuous skip metastases within the same bone are T3; multifocal (multicentric) disease is recorded separately. M splits pulmonary-only (M1a, better prognosis) from other distant sites (M1b). Histologic response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (necrosis 90 percent or higher) is the dominant post-treatment prognostic factor.

t.label: Tumour 8 cm or smaller in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 8 cm in greatest dimension
Discontinuous tumours (skip metastases) in the primary bone site

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
No regional lymph node metastasis (the usual case)
Regional lymph node metastasis (rare; worse prognosis)

m.label: Metastasis to other distant sites (bone, liver, brain), with or without lung disease

stageGroups.basis: Low grade (G1), large or skip tumour

versions.regionalNodes: Bone sarcomas spread haematogenously; nodal basins follow the primary site but N1 is rare. Skip lesions within the same bone are T3 (not M1); a second lesion in a different bone is M1b.
versions.histologicGrade: Low grade (G1: parosteal osteosarcoma, clear-cell chondrosarcoma) vs high grade (G2/G3: conventional osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, dedifferentiated/mesenchymal chondrosarcoma). Necrosis after neoadjuvant chemotherapy (Huvos grade; 90 percent or higher is good response) is reported separately.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Conventional (osteoblastic, chondroblastic, fibroblastic) osteosarcoma; telangiectatic, small-cell, parosteal, periosteal and high-grade surface osteosarcoma; Ewing sarcoma (EWSR1-rearranged); chondrosarcoma variants arising in bone.
prognosticFactors: Pulmonary-only vs other metastasis (M1a vs M1b)
